title: Human Resource Executive
description:
Role & responsibilities Handle recruitment for plant, production, quality control, engineering, maintenance, warehouse, and administrative positions. Maintain employee records, attendance, leave, and HR documentation. Coordinate payroll processing, salary inputs, overtime, and employee benefits. Handle joining formalities, induction, employee engagement, and exit procedures. Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements, and company HR policies. Coordinate with the factory and department heads to understand manpower requirements. Maintain records related to employee training, safety induction, and HR audits. Coordinate with the EHS and factory administration teams regarding employee safety awareness and workplace policies. Support contractor manpower management, labour documentation, and statutory compliance, where applicable. Address employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace concerns. Prepare HR reports, maintain personnel files, and support management with HR-related activities. 

 Preferred candidate profile Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience in HR operations or recruitment; experience in a chemical, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or industrial company is preferred. Knowledge of recruitment, payroll coordination, attendance management, and employee relations. Familiarity with applicable labour laws, PF, ESIC, professional tax, and other statutory compliance requirements. Experience handling blue-collar, contractual, and white-collar manpower will be an advantage. Good communication, interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, and HR management systems. Ability to coordinate with factory management, production teams, and employees at different levels. Willingness to work at the manufacturing plant or factory location, as required. 
 Perks and benefits Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience. Exposure to HR operations in a chemical manufacturing environment. Supportive work culture and opportunities for career advancement. Other benefits as per company policy.

Key Skills: Resource,Talent management,Workforce management,Workforce,Performance management,Performance,Management,Resource management
